title: Universal strong Kadison–Kastler stability for von Neumann algebras
exact_target: For every $\varepsilon >0$, is there $\delta >0$ such that any two unital von Neumann algebras on the same complex Hilbert space, with the same identity and two-sided unit-ball Hausdorff distance below $\delta $, are conjugate by a unitary u satisfying $||u-1||<\varepsilon $? The bound must be independent of both algebras and of the Hilbert space.
